scope: Independent read-only review of other owners renderer/view/source-port and standalone Godot generator/export host; product was not edited by this reviewer. Current hashes must match final parent freeze.

resolvedFindings.before: Read initial renderer normalize3 used value / Math.hypot(...value). Accepted [5e-324,0,5e-324] rounded its denominator to5e-324, yielding [1,0,1] instead of a unit direction. Fragment shader assumes lightDirection is normalized.
resolvedFindings.after: Owner changed the new math adapter to divide by maximum component first, then normalize scaled components. Actual pinned-runtime probe now produces [0.7071067811865475,0,0.7071067811865475], length1, matching exporter double-scaled normalization.
resolvedFindings.probe: cross-math-initial.json records actual already-fixed math when the independent probe ran, not a pre-fix snapshot.

resolvedFindings.origin: Root identified fixed4/3 layout before this review.
resolvedFindings.after: Valid parsed viewport updates surface.style.aspectRatio for each refresh; drawing-buffer aspect uses actual bounds. CSS4/3 remains only the empty initial default. Existing owner tests inspect16/9 and portrait updates.

checkedBoundaries.result: Analytical mixed Euler XYZ and T*Rx*Ry*Rz*S match frontend matrix math and explicit Godot rotation_order0/Basis.from_euler(XYZ). Flat axial box normals may rotate alone under positive nonuniform size. Camera view is Y-up RH with forward-Z negative.

UI receives dedicated read-only source/context ports. Runtime token includes load, preview epoch and actual raw source changes. Async source fetch is rechecked against current sourcePath/token/epoch and dialog ownership. Renderer has no save, HTTP, filesystem or World ports.

Orbit/zoom clone camera fields without mutating model/source, reset restores authored camera; selection is read-only. Close/dispose advances epoch, releases observers/listeners/shaders/program/VAO/buffer/context and blocks late work. Invalid drafts retain a clearly identified last-valid preview.
Missing independent core3D export disables only this preview. WebGL2 absence/context loss yields declarative diagnostic without source rewrite or 2D fallback.

Explicit existing input is bounded/fatalUTF8/no-follow and author source bytes round-trip with BOM/CRLF. New output only is created; source.json/plan.json/project.godot/scene.tscn/runtime.gd plus manifest are frozen under private receipt SHA/inode identity. Existing outputs are never adopted.

WeakMap session-branded receipt authorizes exactly one bounded identify/import/check/probe attempt. Tool is explicit absolute executable and pinned. Before/after each phase all six owned files are checked; only engine-created named cache roots/UID sidecar become permitted after execution starts. Links/special/hardlinks/unregistered source refuse.
Rollback checks exact owned inode/nlink/bytes before unlink; modified or foreign files remain. No recursive deletion/adoption. Empty directory removal only, source input unchanged.

Actual Godot finite probe binds ordered UUIDs, names, position, size, material color, degree declaration, XYZ basis columns, camera/fov/frustum and normalized light; malformed or duplicate probe lines refuse. Existing2D event/behavior/backend project service remains untouched.

limitations: GPU rendering and Godot rendering have different materials/tone pipelines; only coordinate/geometry/plan parity is asserted, not pixel parity.
Float32 raster precision at extreme100000 positions and tiny0.001 objects can lose detail; native finite schema admission does not promise high-precision GPU pixels.
Explicit trusted local tool and same-process/same-user ownership checks are not hostile-code or concurrent filesystem security sandboxes.

3D is a standalone static-box prototype; no assets, object definitions, hierarchy, behavior, 2D build/runtime-service participation, persisted 3D project catalog, installed IDE or Android device acceptance is claimed.
